_meta.policy_name: Custom Private Server Magic Policy v1
_meta.authorization: User explicitly authorized rebuilding unrecoverable EOL server-only Summon mechanics from scratch on 2026-08-19.
_meta.boundary: Recovered MID70/MID71 request shapes, costs, target allow-list, owned-target gate, source fragment rate table, pool700008 membership/weights, and client mutation channels remain source authority. Multiplicity, response placement and retry behavior below are explicit private-server choices.

response_channels.result: Exactly the random byproduct rows from recovered dropbox700008; one row per private-policy byproduct roll.
response_channels.stick_items: Exactly one selected-target fragment bundle. This uses the client's separate extra-award channel and avoids double-crediting through result/reward.
response_channels.summon_config_reward_50005182: Not granted in private v1. summon.lua labels/configures Magic Juice, but source does not prove it should be an additional Backpack award after the purchase action.

retry_policy.reason: Stock MID70 request has no unique operation token. Private v1 favors at-most-once Crystal charging and result mutation for immediate transport retries.
retry_policy.tradeoff: A deliberate identical purchase for the same selected target repeated within the window is treated as a retry.

notes: Leave empty to use recovered dropbox700008 row weights and recovered magic_drop_rate quantities/rates.
Future balancing may override a dropbox row_id weight or a fragment quantity rate here without changing transaction or response code.
Zero is allowed to disable a candidate/rate in a future private balance revision; the planner fails closed if all effective weights become zero.
